sinopsis.es: Con la guía del director y la ayuda de la pintura, un líder comunitario reconstruye los recuerdos de la última década de su vida. A medida que organiza su memoria de manera visual, el entrevistado va construyendo la imagen de una profunda transformación personal tras la catástrofe ambiental que marcó su destino: el mayor desastre de la historia de Brasil y uno de los más devastadores de la humanidad.
sinopsis.en: Prompted by the director, who provides tools based on plastic studies, a community leader paints a memory of his last ten years on canvas. As he visually organizes his memories, our interviewee gradually sketches an image of a deep personal transformation since when his life was crossed by a natural catastrophe, the biggest in the history of Brazil and one of the biggest in humanity.
